description: Azgard Nine Limited is a composite denim producer listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, incorporated in 1993 as Indigo Denim Mills Limited and renamed Azgard Nine Limited in 2004. From spinning through weaving, dyeing, laundry and stitching it makes yarn, denim fabric and denim garments — the company describes the chain as a complete denim and jeans ecosystem — with its registered and head office at Ismail Aiwan-e-Science in Lahore and manufacturing units in Kasur and Lahore. ANLNV is the exchange line for the company's non-voting ordinary shares, a separate class from its voting ordinary shares.
headOffice: Ismail Aiwan-e-Science, Off: Shahrah-e-Roomi, Lahore-54600, Pakistan
